target.label: Real-Venue Launch Readiness - Performance, Trust, Hours, Console Hygiene

tests.reason: This evidence-only trace refresh consumed dated protected validation, final exact-head CI, story records, and existing trace artifacts. It did not rerun implementation suites.

closed_former_gaps.reason: Exact-SHA production route correctness, recovered Vercel request/function/external telemetry, origin MISS p95 below threshold, edge HIT p95 below threshold, zero-error scan, and live SQL delta prove the persisted-read/no-legacy-fan-out route behavior.
Protected geometry/weather jobs, Production variables, service-only batch RPC, and protected Supabase posture are verified.
Protected hidden migration, live visible/hidden smoke with restore, and scoped type-section parity are verified.

Protected venue-media bucket and public-read/no-browser-write policy contract are verified, and the bounded dynamic smoke proved service-role create-only upload, duplicate-version refusal, anonymous 200 image/webp SHA parity, anon/auth write denial, cleanup, and protected SQL remaining_objects=0.
The deferred same-slug visibility race test proves independent concurrent reads without in-flight cache bleed.
Focused future-date exact-response test passed 6/6 with 3 workers and final exact-head CI passed the broad integration lane.

residual_caveats.reason: Recovered Vercel function telemetry classified 21 /api/venues invocations as 3 cold, 1 prewarmed, and 17 hot; all observed cold invocations were under threshold with p95 1827 ms, but strict 20-classified-cold evidence remains under-sampled at n=3.

Canonical external metric recovered 63 total dependencies, all Supabase host, origin route /api/venues, dub1, 200; path dimension is unsupported, so 21 x 3 attribution is inferred from code, Supabase sample evidence, and exact pg_stat delta.
Legacy aggregate telemetry still times out; exact-window request/function telemetry, canonical external telemetry, source contracts, and live SQL delta cover the gate lane.
The protected generated visibility section matches exactly; unrelated broader generated-type drift is not represented as a global parity pass.

recommendations.action: Keep the telemetry wording exact in release notes: recovered Vercel telemetry proves 21 /api/venues invocations with 3 observed classified cold starts under threshold, not 20 classified cold starts; external dependency count is 63 Supabase-host calls with 21 x 3 attribution inferred because path dimension is unsupported.
